observations: Multiple car headlamp units wrapped in clear protective plastic.
The design features a prominent integrated LED strip along the top and side.
A white label is visible on the rear of one unit containing 'LH' and Chinese characters.
The units appear to be in new or refurbished condition based on the wrapping.
Watermark 'IKECHUKWU GLOBAL' is present on the image.

claims.evidence: The visible label contains Chinese characters often associated with aftermarket manufacturers; genuine Mercedes parts typically feature a Mercedes star and a part number starting with 'A'.
The visual style matches the 2013-2015 GLK-Class (X204) facelift, but no brand or model text is legible on the items.
The GLK-Class underwent a facelift in 2013; the 2010-2012 models used a different, more rectangular headlamp design. These appear to be for the 2013-2015 models only.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the Mercedes-Benz star logo and the 10-digit part number molded into the plastic housing.
Photos of the back and sides of the units showing all plastic mounting brackets are intact.
A video showing the headlamp connected to a power source with all light functions (low beam, high beam, LED strip) working.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the manufacturer's label/sticker on the back of the headlamp.
Photo of the Mercedes-Benz logo and part number molded into the black plastic housing.
Photos of the mounting tabs on the top, bottom, and sides.
Video of the headlamp illuminated to verify LED and bulb function.
response.reason: The specific model and whether the part is a genuine Mercedes-Benz 'Original' or an aftermarket replacement cannot be determined from the current photo. The seller's claim of compatibility from 2010-2015 is also questionable as the design changed significantly in 2013.
